mapper.insert:
insert into shebao_payment_plan_detail (plan_id, determination_id, determination_item_id, subsidy_person_id, subsidy_type, street_name, village_name, person_name, id_card_no, business_period, payment_month, monthly_amount, supplement_amount, supplement_start_month, supplement_end_month, supplement_source, supplement_source_id, distribution_amount, distribution_date, grant_org, account_name, bank_account, relation_to_insured, source_detail_id, retry_count, retry_status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark) values
(#{item.planId}, #{item.determinationId}, #{item.determinationItemId}, #{item.subsidyPersonId}, #{item.subsidyType}, #{item.streetName}, #{item.villageName}, #{item.personName}, #{item.idCardNo}, #{item.businessPeriod}, #{item.paymentMonth}, #{item.monthlyAmount}, #{item.supplementAmount}, #{item.supplementStartMonth}, #{item.supplementEndMonth}, #{item.supplementSource}, #{item.supplementSourceId}, #{item.distributionAmount}, #{item.distributionDate}, #{item.grantOrg}, #{item.accountName}, #{item.bankAccount}, #{item.relationToInsured}, #{item.sourceDetailId}, ifnull(#{item.retryCount}, 0), #{item.retryStatus}, #{item.delFlag}, #{item.createBy}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateBy}, #{item.updateTime}, #{item.remark})
mapper.select:
from shebao_payment_plan_detail d left join shebao_payment_plan_detail src on src.id = d.source_detail_id where d.plan_id = #{planId} and d.del_flag = '0'
and d.person_name like concat('%', #{personName}, '%')
and d.id_card_no like concat('%', #{idCardNo}, '%')
order by d.id asc
from shebao_payment_plan_detail d left join shebao_payment_plan_detail src on src.id = d.source_detail_id where d.plan_id = #{planId} and d.del_flag = '0' order by d.id asc
mapper.sql: select d.id, d.plan_id, d.determination_id, d.determination_item_id, d.subsidy_person_id, d.subsidy_type, d.street_name, d.village_name, d.person_name, d.id_card_no, date_format(d.business_period, '%Y-%m') as business_period, d.payment_month, d.monthly_amount, d.supplement_amount, date_format(d.supplement_start_month, '%Y-%m') as supplement_start_month, date_format(d.supplement_end_month, '%Y-%m') as supplement_end_month, d.supplement_source, d.supplement_source_id, d.distribution_amount, date_format(d.distribution_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as distribution_date, d.grant_org, d.account_name, d.bank_account, d.relation_to_insured, d.distribution_result, d.fail_reason, d.source_detail_id as sourceDetailId, d.retry_count as retryCount, d.retry_status as retryStatus, date_format(src.business_period, '%Y-%m') as originalBusinessPeriod
mapper.update: update shebao_payment_plan_detail set distribution_result = 'success' where plan_id = #{planId} and del_flag = '0' and ifnull(distribution_result, '') <> 'failed'
mapper.select: select ifnull(sum(d.distribution_amount), 0) from shebao_payment_plan_detail d where d.plan_id = #{planId} and d.del_flag = '0'
select ifnull(sum(d.distribution_amount), 0) from shebao_payment_plan_detail d where d.plan_id = #{planId} and d.del_flag = '0' and d.distribution_result = 'success'
select ifnull(sum(d.distribution_amount), 0) from shebao_payment_plan_detail d where d.plan_id = #{planId} and d.del_flag = '0' and d.distribution_result = 'failed'
mapper.update:
update shebao_payment_plan_detail set retry_count = ifnull(retry_count, 0) + 1 where id in
#{id}

update shebao_payment_plan_detail set retry_count = greatest(0, ifnull(retry_count, 0) - 1) where id in
#{id}

update shebao_payment_plan_detail set retry_status = 'retry_success' where id in
#{id}

choose.when: select count(*) from shebao_land_loss_resident where del_flag = '0' and approval_status is not null and approval_status != '' and approval_status != 'approved'
select count(*) from shebao_demolition_resident where del_flag = '0' and approval_status is not null and approval_status != '' and approval_status != 'approved'
select count(*) from shebao_expropriatee_subsidy where del_flag = '0' and approval_status is not null and approval_status != '' and approval_status != 'approved'
select count(*) from shebao_village_official where del_flag = '0' and approval_status is not null and approval_status != '' and approval_status != 'approved'

mapper.select: select count(*) from benefit_determination bd join benefit_determination_item bdi on bdi.determination_id = bd.id and bdi.del_flag = '0' where bd.del_flag = '0' and bd.approval_status is not null and bd.approval_status != '' and bd.approval_status != 'approved' and bdi.subsidy_type = #{subsidyType}

select d.id, d.plan_id as planId, p.batch_no as batchNo, p.determination_type as determinationType, d.subsidy_person_id as subsidyPersonId, d.subsidy_type as subsidyType, d.street_name as streetName, d.village_name as villageName, d.person_name as personName, d.id_card_no as idCardNo, date_format(d.business_period, '%Y-%m') as businessPeriod, d.monthly_amount as monthlyAmount, d.supplement_amount as supplementAmount, date_format(d.supplement_start_month, '%Y-%m') as supplementStartMonth, date_format(d.supplement_end_month, '%Y-%m') as supplementEndMonth, d.distribution_amount as distributionAmount, date_format(d.distribution_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as distributionDate, d.grant_org as grantOrg, d.account_name as accountName, d.bank_account as bankAccount, d.relation_to_insured as relationToInsured, d.fail_reason as failReason, p.distribution_status as planDistributionStatus, d.distribution_result as distributionResult, d.source_detail_id as sourceDetailId, d.retry_count as retryCount, d.retry_status as retryStatus, date_format(src.business_period, '%Y-%m') as originalBusinessPeriod, case when #{mode} = 'pre' then null when ifnull(p.distribution_status, '') <> 'completed' then 'distributing' when d.distribution_result = 'failed' and ifnull(d.retry_status, '') = 'retry_success' then 'retry_success' when d.distribution_result = 'failed' then 'failed' else 'paid' end as payStatus from shebao_payment_plan_detail d inner join shebao_payment_plan p on p.id = d.plan_id and p.del_flag = '0' left join shebao_payment_plan_detail src on src.id = d.source_detail_id where d.del_flag = '0' and d.subsidy_person_id = #{subsidyPersonId}
and (p.finance_status is null or p.finance_status = '' or p.finance_status <> 'finance_approved')
and p.finance_status = 'finance_approved'
order by d.id desc
select count(*) from shebao_payment_plan_detail d inner join shebao_payment_plan p on p.id = d.plan_id and p.del_flag = '0' where d.del_flag = '0' and d.subsidy_person_id = #{subsidyPersonId}
